specName: Workflow Builder on stock Spec Kit
request: Workflow Builder on stock Spec Kit: the same lanes and cards, your own hooks through the add modal, and which template layer is in force.
expectations: extension lists with priorities and on/off
preset on/off and priorities, overlays, override creation
skill search in the stock modal
changes to the host stock writers

intent: Redraw the stock Spec Kit board as the same lanes and cards, with your own hooks through the add modal and the template layer in force

verified.result: [plan-check] plan.md: 2 call paths, 6 lines, 1 screen, 12 parts. Every cited file and line checks out.

decisions.decision: A stock add modal of its own on the pb-modal classes
decisions.why: HookModal is typed against Companion steps and choices

decisions.decision: Add Companion sends installCompanion, which runs speckit.companion.installSpecKitExtension
decisions.why: the one command every install surface reuses

decisions.decision: Fixed With Companion copy, no counts
decisions.why: the stock view sends no node counts
decisions.rejected: reading the shipped graph on stock

plan.summary: Stock board rebuilt on the Companion lane, card, popover and modal styles, with three small new surfaces
plan.key_finding: the host already handles add/update/remove stock hooks; only Add Companion needs a new message

tasks.summary: 16 tasks: foundational protocol and CSS, three standalone surfaces, then the board and polish

approach: Rewrite StockBoard as lanes of 2B cards reusing the board CSS. Add a stock hook modal, a hook popover and a documents modal; wire installCompanion through the stock guard to the existing install command.
